Reconcile customer payments, specialist/supplier resources, asset/support duties and data rights; consolidate fees once and do not add transferred cash to the resources it pays for.
A finding without replacement does not remove review, standby, robot maintenance or fallback. Keep capability, exposure, paid labor and avoided-loss claims separate.

unique_accepted_service_ledger.reason: No object/attempt/acceptance/timing ledger to audit the reported scope.

customer_partner_work_hours.reason: Headcount and elapsed window do not disclose individual shifts, attendance, concurrent duties or employer allocation.

paid_hours_removed.reason: No matched feasible baseline, changed roster, avoided hire/overtime or payroll record.

all_payer_costs.reason: No purchase/service price, customer/supplier work cost, standby/repair resource or financing schedule.

outage_effect.reason: No task critical path, actual completion effect or defensible avoided-outage counterfactual.

robot_configuration_and_support.reason: No named configuration, robot failure/repair record, support entitlement or restoration duty.

rights_and_asset_title.reason: Robot title, executed service obligations, data rights and transferability are not disclosed.

retained_deployment_cohort.reason: One episode does not establish repeat use, current supported fleet or later economic retention.

operator_service_audits.model_challenge: Existing utility and paid-crew worlds remain synthetic. The source challenges unpriced review, standby and wider duties; it supplies no rate, crew ratio, cost, outage benefit or payroll coefficient. No new world or numerical calibration is added.

decision_effects.customer: Price useful qualified information or access capability separately from a removable paid shift.
decision_effects.provider: Fund and contract the specialist operating/review/support service before treating delivered hardware as productive capacity.
decision_effects.entry: Newco, acquisition and hybrid paths still require qualified people, assignable obligations and payer cash; acquiring hardware does not establish those rights.
